::: {#def-mh}
#### Metropolis--Hastings algorithm

Given a target posterior $\p(\vth \mid \vy) \propto \p(\vy \mid \vth)\, \p(\vth)$,
a **proposal distribution** $q(\cdot \mid \vth)$,
and a starting value $\vth^{(1)}$,
the **Metropolis--Hastings algorithm** produces $\vth^{(t+1)}$ from $\vth^{(t)}$ as follows
[@dobson4e, Chapter 13, p. 293]:

1. Draw a proposal $\vth^* \sim q(\cdot \mid \vth^{(t)})$.
2. Compute the **acceptance ratio**
   $$
   \alpha \eqdef
   \frac{\p(\vy \mid \vth^*)\, \p(\vth^*)}{\p(\vy \mid \vth^{(t)})\, \p(\vth^{(t)})}
   \cdot
   \frac{q(\vth^{(t)} \mid \vth^*)}{q(\vth^* \mid \vth^{(t)})}.
   $$
3. With probability $\min(1, \alpha)$, set $\vth^{(t+1)} = \vth^*$ (**accept**);
   otherwise set $\vth^{(t+1)} = \vth^{(t)}$ (**reject**).
:::
